title: Node model
description: A controlled node. Unknown fields (e.g. from newer clients) MUST be preserved and ignored by consumers.

capabilities.description: Node capabilities, e.g. shell.exec. Opaque to the engine; new values tolerated.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata, reported by the node. Opaque to the engine.

seat_id.description: Id of the seat this node occupies (PROTOCOL.md §4.7); absent/null when unseated.

platform.description: Self-reported platform descriptor of the node (PROTOCOL.md §4.1). All fields optional; unknown values tolerated.

runtime.description: go | node | deno | bun | browser | electron | python | demo; opaque to the engine.
